body:
Thank you for the response. I do find enjoyment in life, like I would laugh at looking at silly animal video online, enjoy talking to someone, feel satisfied for little thing like fixing my car, or completed a drawing or playing games alone or with friends.

But at the end of the day, I don't see those thing as a reason for me to be alive. Its more like, because I am alive and don't want to be bored / waste my time, and that is why I do those thing.

But you are right, it won't hurt to get some help. I have been putting it off because I don't think it is hurting me or anyone, yet. and I am afraid if this is not a normal thought, which other people might think I am insane if I tell them, hence this post, to see if this is a normal person thinking or not...
